eventDetail.scope: The IEEE WONS conference focuses on the latest advances and challenges in wireless on-demand network systems and services. Its scope covers a broad range of wireless networking technologies, including both established and emerging solutions such as Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, LTE, NR sidelink, NFC, and optical links. The conference addresses networking paradigms like NextG cellular, mesh and sensor networks, vehicular and non-terrestrial networks, and in-body networks. Key topics include robust and adaptive networking in dynamic environments, energy efficiency and sustainability, integration of diverse wireless technologies, self-organizing and self-healing networks, and the application of AI, machine learning, and data analytics to wireless systems. WONS provides a forum for both theoretical and practical research contributions, encouraging innovative solutions, architectures, protocols, and real-world case studies that advance the field of wireless on-demand networking.
